exact_signature_comparison: The primary theorem treats an arbitrary ring map R→A and an arbitrary module sheaf on Spec(A), with no quasicoherence hypothesis. The Lean affine source is the specified affine open U; the base is an affine scheme S; the ring map is the actual s.appLE ⊤ U. Additivity, Leibniz, and annihilation of this base-ring image are the expanded relative derivation conditions. The target is the ordinary derivation on every subopen, with its global action fixed.
complex_wrapper_translation: Every global section of Spec(ℂ) is the image of a scalar under ΓSpecIso.inv. The proved appLE/appTop identity identifies its pullback and restriction with complexConstant; the existing hypotheses therefore discharge the generic base-annihilation condition.
